Feronius qvidqvid in me est, vel à me proficisci po-terit, sibi certo promittere potest, ea enim omnia testimonia libentissime dabo atqve officia adhibebo qvae ad ipsius commendationem magis facere intelli-gam; caeterum si ego DoctissimumMorinum à me amari dixerim, nihil novi di-xerim.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXXVIII.
J. Morinus Card. Barberino obsequium suum testatur.
main_text.p: Eminentissimo & Reverendissimo Principi, Francisco Cardinali Barberino Joannes Morinus Congreg. Orat. Presb. salutem obsequiosissime dicit.
QVanqvam ante paucos dies abeun-ti[?] Domino Coneo literas ad Eminentiam vestram perferendas dederim, qvi

page.notes: The text ends mid-sentence with the catchword "qvi-". The initial Q of "QVanqvam" is a large decorated letter that spans the first two lines. The second line's opening letters are partly obscured by it; "ti" is read with a doubt. The printed text has no space between "Doctissimum" and "Morinum" and is kept as printed. The page has no notes in the margins. A hyphen on "po-terit" and "di-xerim" is at a line end.
